annotations.text:
Salapify 3 design direction, 'Sweldo': calm dark surfaces, one warm orange accent, Plus Jakarta Sans, big tabular peso numbers, four tabs plus a centre Log button.
All figures are sample values.
The Brand tweak on the Home artboard flips the accent to teal, violet or green for comparison.
Low-fi alternate for comparison only: rounder shapes, Nunito, a filled teal hero, pill navigation. Warmer and more playful, less precise. Pick one direction before Phase 1 builds every screen.
